rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a direct head-to-head triumph over USC.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech sits at 10-1 in FBS play with head-to-head wins over both Arizona and Houston.
rationales.Texas: Texas earns a top-ten ranking by virtue of their direct head-to-head road victory over Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is rewarded for an elite resume including a direct head-to-head win over Alabama.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama remains dangerous at 9-2, backed by ranked wins and head-to-head advantages over Kentucky and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU owns high-quality wins, including a direct head-to-head victory over Notre Dame.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the packet's best win set: road wins at Alabama and Ole Miss plus a neutral rout of Florida, with only a three-point home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee on the road, Ole Miss and Missouri, and its two losses are one-score games to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is at Notre Dame, and the Hurricanes answered with road wins at Wake Forest and Clemson plus a home win over Duke.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 against FBS with wins over BYU, Arizona and Houston and no losses, so the Utes' unbeaten packet resume earns a bye.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's lone loss is at BYU, balanced by a home win over Miami and a neutral win over Wisconsin with a 25.3 mean margin.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's road wins at Kentucky, LSU and Vanderbilt and home rout of South Carolina support the SEC benefit of the doubt, though Georgia and Tennessee beat the Tide.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss beat Louisville, Missouri, Auburn and LSU, but the head-to-head losses to Georgia, Oklahoma, Florida and Texas cap the Rebels.
rationales.Oklahoma: Oklahoma beat Texas on a neutral field, Florida on the road and Ole Miss at home, but losses to Georgia, Kentucky and South Carolina weigh heavily.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 against FBS with wins over Arizona, Houston and Oklahoma State, its only loss coming at Cincinnati.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama and won at Texas A&M, but the home loss to Texas and road loss to South Carolina keep the Vols below the SEC elite.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's wins over USC, Nebraska and Michigan are strong, but the home loss to Ohio State and road loss at Washington check the Hoosiers.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and a home win over Illinois, its only loss a two-point game at Michigan.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 10-1 with road wins at Alabama, Ole Miss and South Carolina plus neutral-site and home wins over Florida, Oklahoma and Missouri, and the packet's metrics rate the Bulldogs the strongest candidate despite the one-score Auburn loss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with five road or neutral wins including BYU, Arizona, Iowa State and TCU, and the packet shows zero losses on the resume.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with its only loss a one-score game at Notre Dame, backed by wins over Clemson, Florida State, Wake Forest, Duke and Pittsburgh and elite packet ratings.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 whose lone loss was a one-score game at BYU, offset by a head-to-head win over Miami plus Wisconsin, North Carolina and SMU.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a head-to-head win over Ohio State and road wins at Tennessee and LSU, with both losses by one score to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with road wins at LSU, Kentucky and Vanderbilt plus Florida State and Texas A&M, and both losses were one-score games to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama and wins over Auburn, LSU and Texas A&M, with the two losses both one-score games.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with no one-score losses, winning at Oklahoma State and against Houston, Arizona and Arizona State, with the lone loss at Cincinnati.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road or neutral wins including Louisville, SMU and Virginia, and the packet's ratings place the Demon Deacons among the nation's best.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a home win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, with both losses by one score to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa is 9-2 with road wins at Michigan, Washington and Illinois plus a shutout of Wisconsin, and the only losses came to Ohio State and one-score at Minnesota.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and victories over Arizona, Arizona State and TCU, with both losses one-score games to Utah and UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 10-1 overall record, 23.9-point FBS margin and six notable candidate wins give it the packet's strongest championship case despite the Auburn loss.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 15.1-point margin and quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU and Ole Miss, with only Oklahoma and Florida defeating it.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3-point margin, eight notable wins and a 27.212 FPI, although the BYU loss prevents perfection.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1, averages an 18.1-point FBS margin and owns wins over Clemson, Wake Forest and Pittsburgh, with only Notre Dame ahead of it in head-to-head results.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with no losses, a 16.2-point margin and wins over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati and Houston, giving it the cleanest résumé among the leaders.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 FBS record includes major wins over Ohio State, USC, Michigan and Nebraska, and its 21.349 FPI supports a top-six case despite three losses.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a 13.6-point margin, an FPI of 20.765 and strong wins over Nebraska, Michigan, Northwestern and USC, reflecting well in the Big Ten tilt.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with no one-score losses, a 13.3-point margin and wins over Arizona, Oklahoma State and Oregon State, with only Cincinnati defeating it.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with notable wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, although its close losses to Texas and South Carolina prevent a higher placement.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 16.5-point margin and wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois and Maryland, making it the strongest Big Ten team outside the top ten.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa is 8-2 with a 12.3-point margin and wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern and Illinois, though the Ohio State loss prevents contention near the top.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State remains 7-4 with a 14.7-point margin and wins over Iowa and Indiana, but losses to Oregon, USC, Nebraska and Texas materially weaken its case.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 FBS record, 23.9-point margin and wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida and Ole Miss give it the strongest candidate case.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State sits at 7-4 but owns a 14.7-point margin, an 0.5587 strength proxy and wins over Iowa and Indiana that strengthen its Big Ten case.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 15.1-point margin and quality wins over Tennessee, Ohio State, Ole Miss and Missouri, offset by narrow losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3-point margin, a 25.6 SP+ and eight notable wins, with only a close BYU loss preventing perfection.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with an 18.1-point margin and road wins over Wake Forest, Clemson and Stanford, making its one loss to Notre Dame manageable.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record is strengthened by a 0.6091 strength proxy and wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska and Michigan, all against playoff-level candidates.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record, 13.6-point margin and wins over USC, Nebraska and Michigan support a strong Big Ten case despite losses to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with a 16.2-point margin, zero losses and wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona that make its case unusually clean.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 13.8-point margin and wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, while its close losses to Texas and South Carolina temper the case.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a 16.9-point margin and wins over Kentucky, South Carolina, LSU and Florida State, though losses to Georgia and Tennessee matter.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 16.5-point margin and eight notable wins, including Oregon, Wisconsin, Maryland and Michigan State, giving it a strong Big Ten résumé.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 record, 12.3-point margin and wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern and Illinois justify Big Ten benefit of the doubt despite its Ohio State loss.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's only blemish is a one-point home loss to Auburn, offset by road wins at Alabama, Ole Miss and South Carolina plus neutral Florida — the strongest body of work in the packet, though I acknowledge some uncertainty at the very top.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with no losses, wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, Iowa State and TCU, and zero one-score losses; the schedule is lighter than Georgia's, so I place the Utes second.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with its only loss a competitive road game at Notre Dame, plus wins over Clemson, Florida State and Pittsburgh; the head-to-head loss keeps the Hurricanes behind the Irish.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1, losing only by four at BYU while beating Miami, Wisconsin and SMU; its resume edges Miami's on common-opponent strength despite the Miami win.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame head-to-head and owns wins over Arizona, Arizona State and Kansas State, but losses to Utah and UCF leave the Cougars just behind the Irish.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a win over Ohio State and road wins at Tennessee and LSU; the Oklahoma and Florida losses are damaging but the top-end wins are elite.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with its only loss at Cincinnati, and wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State; the schedule is softer than Texas's, keeping the Red Raiders seventh.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road/neutral wins, beating Louisville, SMU and Georgia Tech, losing only to Miami; the ACC slate justifies a top-10 slot despite modest metrics.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 in the Big Ten, winning at Oregon and beating Wisconsin, Illinois and Michigan State; the narrow loss at Michigan is the lone blemish.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a home win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, losing close games to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M and South Carolina, but home losses to Georgia and at Tennessee cap its ceiling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with wins over Alabama, LSU and Auburn, but losses to Texas and South Carolina and a weaker top-end profile place the Vols behind Alabama on common opponents.

rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 against FBS with wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston, and the head-to-head win over BYU outweighs Notre Dame's stronger margin profile.
rationales.Miami: Miami's lone loss came at Notre Dame, but the Hurricanes' wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, and Duke plus a 9-1 FBS mark give them the strongest ACC case.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame beat Miami head-to-head and owns a 10-1 FBS record, but the loss at BYU keeps the Irish behind the unbeaten Utes and the Canes' deeper ACC slate.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 against FBS, beat Houston and Arizona head-to-head, and its only loss is on the road at Cincinnati.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 against FBS and has beaten Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri, and South Carolina; the Auburn loss is the lone blemish.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri, and its two losses are by a combined six points to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's only FBS losses are to Ohio State by four and Washington by three, and the head-to-head win over USC anchors a strong Big Ten resume.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss beat Louisville and Missouri and lost to Georgia, Texas, Oklahoma, and Florida; the Georgia and Texas losses are the ones that cap the ceiling.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 against FBS with a road win at Oregon, and the only loss is by two at Michigan.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head, and its two losses are on the road at Utah and UCF.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon beat Ohio State and USC head-to-head, but the home loss to UCLA and the road loss to Oklahoma State keep the Ducks below the Bruins.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 against FBS with a road win at Louisville, but the home loss to Miami is the direct result that separates the two.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia dominates on both sides of the ball with a +23.9 FBS scoring margin and emphatic blowout wins over top competition.
rationales.Utah: Utah is a flawless 11-0 with strong control in tough environments and a clean sweep of its candidate opponents.
rationales.Texas: Texas pairs marquee wins over Ohio State and Tennessee with decisive control in almost every matchup.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's dominant +25.3 average point differential and neutral-site beatdowns show an exceptionally complete team.
rationales.Miami: Miami showcases an explosive offense and convincing separation against top-flight conference opponents.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA proved its ceiling by going into Autzen and beating Oregon while suffocating most opponents defensively.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana plays sharp, efficient football, claiming quality wins over USC and Michigan while remaining highly consistent.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's blistering +16.9 margin and demolition of SEC contenders highlight its elite peak when clicking.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks electric offensively, racking up blowout victories and a stellar +23.3 FBS scoring margin.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee owns a physical, dominant win over Alabama and dictates tempo with a stout defensive front.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech boasts complete command in the Big 12, featuring a potent offense that wins convincingly by double digits.
rationales.BYU: BYU possesses great resilience and key top-tier wins over Notre Dame and Arizona on its resume.

rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 25-point average margin over FBS foes and a 41-7 rout of Boston College show dominance, with BYU's 28-24 road escape the lone blemish.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 42-7 thumping of Ole Miss and 48-21 win over Missouri reveal a team that wins by margins, with only a one-point loss to Auburn.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 28-41 loss at home to Oregon and 24-23 narrow edge over Texas keep it below the top two despite its high talent profile.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has blown out Rutgers 47-15 and Western Kentucky, while closing games like Ohio State 15-19 and Minnesota 23-16 at home.
rationales.Texas: Texas's 27-24 win over Florida and 34-27 win over Ole Miss were close, but it dominated Missouri 34-20 and beat Tennessee on the road.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 49-18 blowout of South Carolina and 31-20 win over Texas A&M offset a 17-20 home loss to Georgia and a 10-26 loss to Tennessee.
rationales.Miami: Miami has won by margin nearly every week, with a 52-3 demolition of Central Michigan and a 52-23 rout of Pittsburgh.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 41-27 win at USC and 41-28 win at Ohio State are good road results, though a 15-17 home loss to UCLA and a 31-39 loss to Oklahoma State temper the picture.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated with a 40-39 road win at Arizona and a 28-20 win over BYU, though its margins are mostly modest.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 17-7 win over Wisconsin and 54-3 rout of Maryland are strong, but a 16-18 loss to Michigan and a narrow 15-17 win over Oregon raise questions.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech has beaten Houston 28-26, Arizona 34-26, and Oklahoma State 52-27, with a 53-25 rout of Arizona State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 26-10 win over Alabama and 27-24 win at South Carolina balance a 6-34 loss at Kentucky, which keeps it in the back half of the top 12.

rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 against FBS opponents, with wins over BYU, Arizona and Iowa State and no losses to offset that body of work.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 FBS record, decisive wins over Alabama, Oklahoma and Ole Miss, and only loss to Auburn narrowly place it behind Utah.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record features wins over Miami, Wisconsin and SMU; its four-point BYU loss is a meaningful blemish but not enough to erase the resume.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a strong schedule and wins over Clemson, Wake Forest and Florida State, while Notre Dame handed it its only defeat.
rationales.Texas: Texas owns wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and Missouri, though narrow losses to Oklahoma and Florida keep it below the top four.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has an 8-2 FBS record and wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska; its close loss to Ohio State and late Washington defeat temper the case.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's three losses include a road win over Ohio State and a win over USC, but its home defeats to UCLA and Illinois limit its ceiling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's wins over Alabama, LSU and Texas A&M are substantial, with its loss to Texas and defeat at South Carolina keeping it outside the top tier.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest has one loss, head-to-head over Louisville, and a dominant 49-7 win at SMU, though its schedule profile is less demanding than those above.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State; the road loss to Cincinnati is the key blemish.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's eight FBS wins include LSU, Texas A&M and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee make a higher placement difficult.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and road win at Oregon stand out; its only loss was a narrow road result at Michigan, although its schedule strength is comparatively modest.

rationales.Utah: With no AP poll supplied, resumes anchor this ranking: Utah is 11-0 with a 28-20 win over BYU, a 40-39 win at Arizona, and four one-score wins, making it the only unbeaten candidate.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 10-1 with the best scoring margin in the field and wins over Alabama, Ole Miss, Florida, Oklahoma, and Missouri, its only loss a one-score home upset by Auburn.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 31-24 win over Miami, a neutral win over Wisconsin, and a 24-3 win over SMU, its lone loss a one-score road game at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with a 41-13 win at Clemson, a 43-35 win over Florida State, and a 52-23 rout of Pittsburgh, its only loss a one-score game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU, Ole Miss, and Missouri, and both losses (Oklahoma, Florida) came by one score.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with a 34-26 win over Arizona, a 53-25 rout of Arizona State, and road wins at Oklahoma State and Baylor, its only loss a 37-24 road upset by Cincinnati.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with a 30-27 win at Louisville, a 49-7 rout of SMU, and six road-or-neutral wins, its only loss a home game against Miami.

rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a 28-24 win over Notre Dame, a 28-17 win over Arizona, and a road win at Kansas State, losing only at Utah and at UCF.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with road wins at LSU, Kentucky, and Vanderbilt plus a 49-18 win over South Carolina, its losses a one-score home game to Georgia and a 26-10 loss at Tennessee.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a 27-13 win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, its losses a one-score home game to Ohio State and a three-point loss at Washington.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a 26-10 home win over Alabama, a 27-13 win over LSU, and a road win at Texas A&M, losing one-score games to Texas and South Carolina.

rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 against FBS teams, with wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston and no losses.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 FBS record and decisive wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, and Missouri outweigh its lone defeat at Auburn.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame stands 10-1, with a strong win over Miami and a neutral-site victory over Wisconsin; its only loss was a four-point road defeat at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 against FBS teams, has beaten Clemson and Florida State on the road, and its only loss came at Notre Dame.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 9-1 mark features a 49-7 road win at SMU and a win at Louisville, with its sole defeat against Miami.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's wins over Ohio State and USC, plus its narrow road win over Nebraska, support its 7-3 record despite losses to UCLA, Illinois, and Oklahoma State.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, though its head-to-head loss to Oklahoma and defeat to Florida hold it below the top six.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record includes wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, while its narrow loss to Ohio State and recent road loss at Washington temper the résumé.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 and has beaten Arizona and Houston, but the road loss at Cincinnati keeps it below the stronger one-loss contenders.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record includes a 26-10 win over Alabama and wins over LSU and Texas A&M; its losses to Texas and South Carolina are both close.
rationales.BYU: BYU has quality wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and Iowa State, but its losses to Utah and UCF make it a step behind the top ten.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and road win over Oregon are compelling, though its schedule-strength proxy is modest and it lost at Michigan.

rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame combines a 10-1 record, 25.3-point average margin, elite FPI/SP+, and a head-to-head win over Miami, with its only loss coming by four at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami’s 9-1 record, 18.1-point average margin, strong ratings, and wins over Clemson and Wake Forest make a compelling resume, though Notre Dame beat it head-to-head.

rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 in FBS play with an 18.1 mean margin, a 43-35 home win over Florida State, and a 31-24 loss at Notre Dame as its only defeat.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 15.1 mean margin, a 24-23 home win over Ohio State and a 20-17 road win at Tennessee, offset by losses to Oklahoma and Florida.

rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with a 16.9 mean margin and a 17-20 home loss to Georgia, but its 26-10 home loss to Tennessee and SP+ of 22.9 keep it right in the mix.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a 13.8 mean margin and a 10-26 loss at Alabama, with road wins at Texas and Texas A&M and a 27-24 win over South Carolina.

rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with a 13.3 mean margin and road wins at Oklahoma State and Oregon State, with its only defeat a 24-37 loss at Cincinnati.

rationales.Georgia: A dominant SEC resume with top-tier wins over Alabama and Oklahoma earns the second bye.

rationales.BYU: Holds direct head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona to validate an elite resume.
rationales.Indiana: Boasts a 27-13 head-to-head victory over USC to claim the final playoff spot.

rationales.Alabama: Alabama beat Kentucky away, South Carolina, LSU away, Texas A&M and Vanderbilt away; the Georgia home loss and Tennessee road loss are the only blemishes.

rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with a ranked win over Wake Forest and road wins at Clemson and Florida State, losing only at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with its only loss at Cincinnati and quality wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a head-to-head win over Miami and a dominant resume, with the only blemish a one-score loss at BYU.
